defects.label: Roof damage
defects.look_for: missing or curling shingles, damaged flashing, sagging roof lines

defects.label: Chimney or fireplace damage
defects.look_for: crumbling or spalling chimney brick, failed mortar, leaning chimney, damaged crown or cap, cracked firebrick

defects.label: Gutters or downspouts
defects.look_for: detached, sagging, clogged or leaking gutters, missing downspouts or extensions

defects.label: Grading or yard drainage
defects.look_for: ground sloping toward the house, standing water, soil erosion beside the foundation

defects.label: Siding or exterior envelope
defects.look_for: rotted, cracked or missing siding or soffit, cracked stucco, failed caulk or paint on the outer surface (not window or door frames, not cracks through brick or block walls)

defects.label: Deck or porch
defects.look_for: rotted or loose deck boards, corroded or unsupported posts, pulling-away ledger board

defects.label: Walkways, driveway or retaining wall
defects.look_for: heaved or cracked concrete steps and paths, trip edges, leaning or bulging retaining wall

defects.label: Water intrusion
defects.look_for: water stains, active leaks, moisture damage on walls or ceilings

defects.label: Basement or crawl space moisture
defects.look_for: standing water, white mineral deposits, water lines on basement walls, wet crawl space insulation, faulty sump pump

defects.label: Mold or mildew
defects.look_for: visible mold or mildew growth

defects.label: Foundation or structural cracks
defects.look_for: cracks in foundation, walls, or structural members, stepped or diagonal cracks through brick, block or masonry walls, failing mortar joints, bowed walls, sagging beams or joists

defects.label: Electrical hazard
defects.look_for: exposed wiring, scorched outlets, missing cover plates, improvised wiring, missing GFCI outlets near water

defects.label: Electrical panel problem
defects.look_for: open or rusted panel, missing knockouts, double-tapped or scorched breakers, burned wires inside the panel

defects.label: Plumbing problem
defects.look_for: leaking or corroded pipes, fixture leaks, failed supply lines, visibly old or mismatched piping

defects.label: Water heater problem
defects.look_for: rust or leaks at the tank, corroded fittings, missing relief valve or discharge pipe, improper venting

defects.label: Heating system problem
defects.look_for: rusted or scorched furnace or boiler, disconnected or corroded flue, soot, damaged ductwork

defects.label: Cooling system problem
defects.look_for: damaged or corroded outdoor unit, bent coil fins, missing refrigerant line insulation, water stains below the air handler

defects.label: Insulation or ventilation problem
defects.look_for: missing, compressed or wet insulation, blocked attic vents, frost or condensation in the attic, bath fan venting into the attic

defects.label: Window or door damage
defects.look_for: rotted, soft or crumbling wood in window or door frames, sills, jambs, thresholds or trim, broken glass or seals, doors that do not close

defects.label: Wall or ceiling finish damage
defects.look_for: cracked drywall, nail pops, peeling paint, sagging ceiling with no water stain

defects.label: Flooring damage
defects.look_for: buckled, cupped or lifting boards, broken tile, soft or sloping floor, stained subfloor

defects.label: Stairs or railings
defects.look_for: loose, missing or too-low handrails and guardrails, uneven or damaged steps

defects.label: Pest or wood damage
defects.look_for: termite mud tubes, crumbly dirt-like packed material on wood or inside walls, tunnels in wood, carpenter ant damage, rodent evidence; only when pests or their traces are visible, plain rot is not this

defects.label: Smoke or CO alarm issue
defects.look_for: missing, painted-over or yellowed old smoke or carbon monoxide alarms, dangling or disconnected alarms

defects.label: Suspected hazardous material
defects.look_for: popcorn ceiling, old vinyl floor tile, wrapped pipe insulation, flaking old paint, oil tank (all need lab testing)

defects.label: Septic or sewer problem
defects.look_for: sewage on the ground, broken cleanout or tank lid, soggy lush patch over a drain field, sewage backup

defects.label: Fire or smoke damage
defects.look_for: charred framing, scorch marks, soot staining, melted wiring or fixtures

defects.label: Cannot determine
defects.look_for: the photo does not show enough to decide
